description: This file defines a React component called ProtectedRoute, which acts as a route guard in a React application using react-router-dom. It ensures that only authenticated users can access certain routes by checking authentication status and redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page. The component also handles loading state while authentication status is being determined.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ children })
methods.description: React component that protects routes based on user authentication status.
